item.description:
Founded in 2020 out of Anaheim Hills, The Blue Byrdes pull from the well that classic rock dug deep – the Allman Brothers, Stevie Ray Vaughan, Eric Clapton, Jimi Hendrix – and run it through a younger set of hands. Soulful melody, loud honest playing, arrangements that breathe. They are not reviving the old sound so much as refusing to let it sit still. ​ Cut from The Allman Brothers Stevie Ray Vaughan Eric Clapton Jimi Hendrix

item.title: LAERZ — Thu Oct 1, 7:00 PM — Songbyrd
item.description: LAERZ is an LA based electronic artist redefining what a DJ set can be. Blurring the line between live production and performance, he builds tracks in real time, stacking cinematic vocals, sculpting synths, triggering drum pads, and weaving loops into fully immersive, high voltage moments. No two sets are the same. Every drop is built live. Every chorus feels earned. He first captured global attention through his busking style performances and on the spot content creation, transforming sidewalks and unexpected spaces into stages. That raw, human approach resonated, building a fiercely organic audience of over 4 million followers across social media. That momentum translated offline as well, culminating in a 22 date headline tour that brought his immersive live show to audiences across the country. item.description: Ella Boh is a dark pop artist based in Los Angeles, California crafting haunting melodies, cinematic storytelling, and self-written and self-produced records. She has built one of alternative pop’s fastest-growing communities and cultivated a dedicated global audience through immersive visuals and emotionally raw storytelling. Following the success of her debut project milk & honey, Ella launched her darkest and most ambitious era yet with the BLURRY EP. Led by fan-favorite releases "SERiAL KiLLER," "iNSOMNiAC," and "BLOODY MARY," the project has amassed more than 9.2 million Spotify streams, reached more than 1 million listeners, generated over 400K playlist adds, and contributed to a catalog that now exceeds 56+ million global lifetime streams. The release was supported by more than 14K presaves, international editorial support, and tour dates alongside Artemas and Ari Abdul. item.title: The R&B Club Discusses The Legacy of Aaliyah — Sun Aug 23, 12:00 PM — Songbyrd
item.description: Certain moments in this century have stayed with us. And they always will. August 25, 2001, is just that. It seems almost surreal to say, but The R&B Club’s next event comes almost a quarter-century to the day that the R&B icon Aaliyah tragically passed away. There's no way not to have a connection to her music, but more importantly, Aaliyah herself. If you know anything about us, and what we pride ourselves on, this won't be simply music being played. This is a voyage and a trip back in time into one of the most captivating and abbreviated careers in music history. We’ll discuss it all. The highs, the classic records, where we were when we got the news of her death — and, yes, the R. Kelly of it all. It's one time for Babygirl (better known as Aaliyah) on Sunday, August 23, at the only home we've ever known in Songbyrd. Tickets are $15 in advance and $20 at the door — pending there's any left. item.title: Staring in Spaces (Single Release Show) — Sat Oct 10, 7:00 PM — Songbyrd
item.description: Saturday October 10th Staring in Spaces (Single Release Show) w/ Endlings \+ FREE after party w/ DJ FIBI and Yoshmo! \*\*\* Staring in Spaces: The pop duo bringing infectious energy to the Nation's Capital. Childhood friends Jack Wright and William Lorenz began their musical journey in small-town Wisconsin, quickly gaining momentum with their debut album Stop Talking. Now settled in D.C., Staring in Spaces released their boldest and most ambitious album yet, Kissing!, at the end of 2024. Featuring standout singles like the punchy "my mom/your dad" and the nostalgic "Postcard," the album pushes their pop sensibilities into rougher textures and edgier performances. With a successful tour behind them and energized audiences craving more. Wright and Lorenz are diving headfirst into 2026. \*\*\* Endlings are four friends making music at the event horizon. Saturday October 10th SIS The Afterparty! ft. DJ FIBI & Yoshmo \*\*\* Stay after the SiS Single Release Show for THE AFTERPARTY! DJ FIBI and Yoshmo are going to absolutely rock our socks off with two amazing sets back to back 🪩 10pm - DJ FIBI 🕺 12am - Yoshmo \*\*\* FIBI is a Washington, DC based DJ blending progressive house, tech house, melodic bass, hyperpop, and disco genres into energetic, pop-driven sets. Influenced by fresh alternative EDM and eurodance classics, FIBI creates a high-energy community-driven dance floor that keeps people moving all night. \*\*\* DC based dj, Yoshmo, is a new face in the budding DMV DJ scene. Playing everything from electro and hyperpop to jungle and hardcore, there’s never a dull moment on the dance floor when they’re behind the decks!
